description: This file defines a command handler for creating and sending various rich card messages (such as info, image, action, list, receipt, confirm, buttons) in LINE chat via a plugin API. It includes parsing functions for command arguments and constructs different card types based on user input.

methods.name: buildLineReply
methods.description: Constructs a ReplyPayload object with channel data for LINE.

methods.name: parseActions
methods.description: Parses a string of actions into an array of CardAction objects, supporting URL, message, and postback types.

methods.name: parseListItems
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of list items into an array of ListItem objects.

methods.name: parseReceiptItems
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of receipt items into objects with name and value.

methods.name: parseCardArgs
methods.description: Parses command argument string into card type, arguments, and flags.
